run_azure_chat_benchmark: run the Azure chat API benchmark script to measure latency and throughput across concurrent request levels
run_generate_text: run the generate_text function to send a single chat completion request to the Azure API endpoint
run_evaluate_performance: run evaluate_performance with a concurrency level to measure P50/P99 latency, RPS, and tokens per second
review_generate_text: review the generate_text function that sends a chat payload to the Azure API and returns latency and token count
review_evaluate_performance: review the evaluate_performance function that uses ThreadPoolExecutor to benchmark concurrent API requests and compute metrics
